description: This source file contains functions related to processing documents in a multilingual translation workflow. It handles reading files, parsing front matter and body content, translating segments, updating front matter with translations, and saving the translated content.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: reads, splits front matter, translates content, updates front matter, and writes the output.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the content into front matter (YAML) and body, based on delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes the front matter map into a YAML string with proper formatting and additional metadata.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific fields within the front matter such as title, summary, and read_when.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates individual text snippets with caching support, used for front matter fields.
